breakpoints.note: After `TYPE65` sets `s->r_type` to HTTPS, `_text_r_data` dispatches this witness into `r_data_svcb`. The preceding `9` priority and target `G` satisfy the `num16 . sep . r_dname` prefix, so the remaining input reaches `svcb_params` on the tokens `key0=<65520-byte text>`, `key6`, and `key3`.

First project-code materialization of attacker data into vulnerability-relevant parser state: the numeric suffix of the witness token `TYPE65` is stored as record type 65/HTTPS, which is the only reason the later rdata dispatch enters the vulnerable SVCB/HTTPS parameter parser.

On the witnessed path this action runs for trailing `key3` with only two bytes left in the buffer. The fix patch adds `if (rdata_tail + 4 > rdata_stop + 1) { WARN(ZS_RDATA_OVERFLOW); ... }` at this exact site, which would reject `key3` before any further writes.
